plugins.name: product-brain
plugins.description: The brainify skill + pb CLI: create and maintain a Product Brain hub. Installing puts pb on PATH and makes 'set up product brain' available — no manual copy, no PATH editing. Also ships the brand-system skill (one product-level DESIGN.md, compiled to brand/) and the delivery-roadmap, release-notes, and update-product-hub artifact skills, all styled only from that brand.
